implementation.rowNormalization: Acquire each bounded source row once into the existing packed MCU tile. Share exact scaled-alpha and inverse-alpha products across RGB channels, preserving the original full16-bit single rounding and explicit-background refusal.
implementation.resource: Same8-KiB fixed owner,262144work per subsampled MCU, table owners and372808 allocated bytes/op. No new heap storage, intermediate frame, reservation or refusal fallback. Borrowed inputs/root, cancellation and independent output lifetime unchanged.

qualification.normalizationScope: Every16-bit source value,10 alpha boundaries and8 distinct RGB backgrounds, three channel permutations; unaligned1/2/3/17/18-pixel rows, mixed alpha, opaque/no-background, unchanged input, output guards and missing-background refusal. Existing exhaustive byte-row controls retained.

diagnostics.jit: Optimized scalar per-pixel code already folds constant division; no hardware division or flatten calls. Repeated image row/stride acquisition motivated bounded-row normalization.
diagnostics.prototype: 5242880 arithmetic comparisons and398601 normalized channels preserve the existing complete52115-byte packet before production adoption. The diagnostic oracle owns a full RGB frame; production never allocates that frame.
